title: 宣戦！？いっちょセンター！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon gathers all her fans for a mini performance and an important announcement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She declares her intent to win every dirt race she enters, including the end-of-year Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her proclamation to become the undisputed champion of the dirt gets everyone talking, but her friend Eishin Flash points out that the plan seems out of character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we can find out what that really means, our schedule becomes swamped with interviews for Smart Falcon.
